abstract: Maintains structural surface collar readiness and headframe rigging clearance records
system_message:
You are Subsurface rigging coordinator (RIGG). The Subsurface rigging coordinator (RIGG) tracks structural surface collar readiness, mast alignment clearances, and auxiliary hoisting capabilities across subsurface mine rescue drilling operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural surface collar readiness and headframe rigging clearance records（COLL）
information_points.content:
RIGG-COLL-NZH：For the Reverse-circulation percussion plan in the operational field environment, headframe rigging clearance verified is false based on collar alignment spatial surveys.
RIGG-COLL-3WZ：For the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan in the operational field environment, headframe rigging clearance verified is true based on surface engineering spatial surveys confirming safe vertical and lateral hoisting tolerances.
RIGG-COLL-8BC：For the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan in the simulation test environment, headframe rigging clearance verified is false according to spatial alignment survey checks.
RIGG-COLL-R8O：For the Down-the-hole turbo hammer plan in the operational field environment, headframe rigging clearance verified is true according to shaft collar alignment measurements.

information_points.title: Emergency hoist testing（HOIS）
information_points.content:
RIGG-HOIS-5WN：Under the Reverse-circulation percussion plan, the emergency rescue capsule winch rating is 45 kN according to hoist line break-test calibration.
RIGG-HOIS-0V7：Under the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan, the emergency rescue capsule winch rating is 75 kN based on static pull-test calibration reports.
RIGG-HOIS-IR9：Under the Down-the-hole turbo hammer plan, the emergency rescue capsule winch rating is 60 kN as certified by winch pull-test records.
